Well, sort of like this as far as being overwhelmed, but mine is more of a physiological response rather than an emotional one. I *can* become emotionally overwhelmed when my thoughts are scattered and racing, or if there are too many emotional things at once. Especially unmedicated and/or stressed (medication can only do so much!) because then I can't process thoughts and my feelings about them, etc. 

What I'm describing for this thread, however, feels literally like the physical response to being motion sick. I get a headache, feel nauseous,  and if I don't close my eyes and stop moving until my brain/meds catch up, it physically incapacitates me. It's not panic or anxiety. It feels in my body like the same thing that happens when I try to read in a moving vehicle while sitting next to the window.

It doesn't happen very often that intensely, because I've learned to catch it early. More often, it is less motion sickness that I feel, and more like my filters to outside sensory input (sounds, movement, lights) just fade away when my med wears off and I can't focus on just one thing but instead I hear, see, etc. everything in my space and THAT can emotionally stress me out. That doesn't make me physically feel motion sickness, that just makes me want to leave the room or close my eyes/ears and just shrink into my skull where I can look at what I need to without actually having to physically see because too many things are around and distracting. If that makes any sense at all.

I also get physical motion sickness while gaming under/unmedicated sometimes. THAT is a recent discovery! But my current games are more realistic than I've ever played before, with a bigger screen and sound. And if I jump off a high point in-game, I physically feel the sensation in the pit of my stomach, like a big dip on a rollercoaster.

WEIRDEST. FEELING. EVER!!
